theorem_title: Transfer of shared catalog tables over an exact memory window
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankData.Tables.of_window {h J k low bound : ℕ} {μ ν : ℕ → ℤ}
    {D : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostLevelData.Catalog} {hk : k ≤ J} {f g : Finset (Fin (J*(464*h))) → ℤ}
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankData.Tables μ D hk f g) (heq : ∀ a, low ≤ a → a < bound → ν a=μ a)
    (hindexLow : low ≤ D.indexBase) (hptrLow : low ≤ D.ptrBase)
    (hboxLow : low ≤ D.boxBase) (hindex : D.indexBase+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingPrefixCatalog.count h k ≤ bound)
    (hptr : D.ptrBase+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingPrefixCatalog.count h k ≤ bound)
    (hbox : D.boxBase+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingPrefixCatalog.count h k*_root_.ThreeSum.LightReportingSuffixCatalog.stride ((J-k)*(464*h)) D.boxCut ≤ bound) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankData.Tables ν D hk f g := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $h,J,k,\ell,u\in\mathbb N$ with $k\le J$, $D$ a catalog and $f,g$ integer-valued functions on subsets of the width-$J\cdot464h$ coordinate set. Suppose its exact table contract holds in $\mu$ and memories $\mu,\nu$ agree on $[\ell,u)$. Assume the index, pointer and box bases are at least $\ell$; the index and pointer arrays of length $N(h,k)$ end by $u$; and the box payload ends by

$$D.\mathrm{boxBase}+N(h,k)\operatorname{stride}((J-k)464h,D.\mathrm{boxCut})\le u.$$

Then the same shared-table contract holds in $\nu$.

This gives precise-window memory framing for independently retained catalog payloads.
